# FDGA014

> DO use spaces between flow control keywords and the open parenthesis.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.1.2 Space Usage.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: IDE0055
- Automatic fix: yes
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

## Options

```ini
csharp_space_after_keywords_in_control_flow_statements = true
```

## From the book

```csharp
Right: while (x == y)
Wrong: while(x == y)
```
